payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 15:1–11 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states paul recalls the message received and delivered: death, burial, third-day raising, and appearances to Cephas, the Twelve, many others, James, apostles, and Paul. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
